description: The access group of every field of the seven IDTA-02035 aspect models of the battery passport that a data provider serves, as Annex XIII of Regulation (EU) 2023/1542 sorts the information of the battery passport.

Text.description: Describes a Property which contains plain text. This is intended exclusively for human readable strings, not for identifiers, measurement values, etc.

ValidFromCharacteristic.description: A calendar date without a time.

TwinLevelEnumeration.description: The two levels of a digital twin: the part type and the part instance.

AccessGroupEnumeration.description: The four access groups of Annex XIII of Regulation (EU) 2023/1542: public (point 1), legitimateInterestModel (point 2), authorities (point 3) and legitimateInterestBattery (point 4).

AccessMapEntry.description: The access group of one field of one aspect model on one level of the digital twin.

aspect.description: The identifier (urn) of the aspect model that the entry covers.

twinLevel.description: The level of the digital twin on which the entry applies to the field.

path.description: The path of the field as a JSONPath query (RFC 9535), relative to the root of the payload of the aspect model; a selector of RFC 9535 names the list elements where the entry covers only some elements of a list.

accessGroup.description: The access group of the field.

legalBasis.description: The point and the letter of Annex XIII of Regulation (EU) 2023/1542 that list the field.

EntriesTrait.description: The list of the entries holds one entry or more.

mapVersion.description: The version of the access map; a new version of Annex XIII or of the implementing act under Art. 77(9) leads to a new value.

validFrom.description: The date from which the access map applies.

entries.description: One entry per field of the seven IDTA-02035 aspect models that the data provider serves.
